review.notes: Checked all 15 hat definitions twice against authoritative English source. Preserved boolean/hide flags, empty fields, slash layouts, and duplicated display-name fields exactly in structure. Names and descriptions received two editorial passes for concise natural Greek, correct material and fit details, distinct color variants, source humor, established Fish-Blob terminology, and the glossary's Wizard naming.
